role_extensions.whole_circle: a complete drawn round (cap, sides and return together) recorded as one construction, distinct from closed_ring, which is kept for eye/pupil rings
role_extensions.dotted_rim: round boundary drawn as a run of leader/dot glyphs (… ‥ ．) stepping around the form, distinct from a solid contour and from a tone field
role_extensions.texture_edge: rounded contour articulated by a column/run of directional texture marks (fur ﾐ ミ 彡 シ ヾ, 爻) that turns with the form, often with an interior tone field stopping against it; no single traced line. Differs from texture_boundary (where a texture field simply ends against sky)
role_extensions.thick_rim_band: rounded rim drawn as two cooperating contours, or a stroke-dot-stroke band (e.g. `!:|`), that turns with a large eye or lid; thickness belongs to that form, not to every round (architectural bands are arch_band)
